issue.title: clang crashes on valid code at -O1 and above on x86_64-linux-gnu: Assertion `N1.getValueType().bitsGT(VT) && "Invalid truncate node, src < dst!"' failed

tests.test_body:
define void @test_64bit_badmask(ptr %existing, ptr %new) {
  %oldval = load volatile i64, ptr %existing, align 4
  %oldval_keep = and i64 %oldval, 135
  %newval = load volatile i64, ptr %new, align 4
  %newval_shifted = shl i64 %newval, 3
  %newval_masked = and i64 %newval_shifted, 664
  %combined = or i64 %oldval_keep, %newval_masked
  store volatile i64 %combined, ptr %existing, align 4
  ret void
}

define i64 @test_truncated_shift(i64 %x, i64 %y) {
entry:
  %and = and i64 %x, -1040187393
  %shl4 = shl i64 %y, 25
  %and5 = and i64 %shl4, 1040187392
  %or = or i64 %and5, %and
  ret i64 %or
}

define <2 x i32> @test_complex_type(ptr %addr, i64 %in, ptr %bf) {
  %vec = load <2 x i32>, ptr %addr, align 8
  %vec.next = getelementptr <2 x i32>, ptr %addr, i32 1
  %lo = ptrtoint ptr %vec.next to i64
  %hi = shl i64 %in, 32
  %both = or i64 %lo, %hi
  store i64 %both, ptr %bf, align 4
  ret <2 x i32> %vec
}

define void @trunc_v8i19_to_v8i8_in_loop(ptr %A, ptr %dst) {
entry:
  br label %loop

loop:                                             ; preds = %loop, %entry
  %iv = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %iv.next, %loop ]
  %gep.A = getelementptr inbounds <8 x i19>, ptr %A, i64 %iv
  %l.A = load <8 x i19>, ptr %gep.A, align 32
  %trunc = trunc <8 x i19> %l.A to <8 x i8>
  %gep.dst = getelementptr inbounds <8 x i8>, ptr %dst, i64 %iv
  store <8 x i8> %trunc, ptr %gep.dst, align 8
  %iv.next = add i64 %iv, 1
  %ec = icmp eq i64 %iv.next, 1000
  br i1 %ec, label %loop, label %exit

exit:                                             ; preds = %loop
  ret void
}

; Make sure we don't crash when shrinking the shift amount before legalization.
define i64 @pr92720(i64 %x) {
  %or = or i64 %x, 255
  %sub = sub i64 0, %or
  %shl = shl i64 1, %sub
  %sext = shl i64 %shl, 32
  ret i64 %sext
}
